name: Social and relationships
summary: What the villagers think of the player: relationship tiers that set prices, quests and greetings; romance from attraction to marriage; the town's standing, fines and bans; gifts; haggling and ordering food; the radial action wheel; and NPC volition.

parameters.doc: spark lost per quiet step, in tenths of a point (RomanceSystem 0.5)
quiet steps before the spark decays (RomanceSystem 3)
steps a rejection holds further attempts off (RomanceSystem 5)
how far below its threshold (tenths) a stage falls back a rung (RomanceSystem 10 points)
spark (tenths) below which an NPC is never jealous (RomanceSystem 30 points)
the key or button held to open the radial wheel (Unreal lists it as the gamepad wheel)

extensionPoints.doc: a world's social actions over the template exporters' eight, merged by id; a parameter-level hook, not Prolog facts
a world's own stages and thresholds (tenths) in place of none → married
what NPCs want of their own accord and the courtship ladder between them (docs/npc-volition.md)

assistant.summary: src/social/ owns relationship strengths and tiers, romance tracks, the town's standing, fines and bans, which gift goes, haggling detection and the action wheel's model; VolitionDirector owns NPC-to-NPC desire and courtship. The engine draws the wheel, the toasts and the reputation panel, and moves the gold and the items.
notes: Hear npc_talked, quest_completed, quest_failed, item_delivered and gift_given with applyRelationshipEvent; hear the same and item_purchased with applyReputationEvent after enterSettlement.
A relationship view is the play-time gate: consult canOfferQuests before a quest offer and pricePermille (with the standing's) at a merchant.
Strengths are thousandths (-1000..1000), romance spark tenths (0..1000), standing whole points (-100..100).
A gift is giveGift then the three kernels in order: relationship, standing, and romance's give_gift when romance runs.
Romance draws are seeded (romanceDraw): give every game one seed so an attempt replays.
npc-temporary-states and social-contact-list are port-later; do not generate them from this pack.
doNot: Let an unaffordable wheel action fire (activateSlot refuses too_tired).
Store NPC names or the current settlement in the save: the world gives the names again and the host re-enters the settlement.
